name: opensips-lsp
description: Language support for opensips.cfg routing scripts (diagnostics via opensips -C, completion, hover, go-to-definition).

opensipsLsp.serverPath.description: Path to the opensips-lsp server binary. Leave at the default to use the server bundled with platform builds of this extension (falling back to a PATH lookup).

opensipsLsp.opensipsPath.description: Path to the opensips binary used for -C diagnostics.

opensipsLsp.opensipsSrc.description: OpenSIPS source tree to harvest module documentation from (completion/hover).

opensipsLsp.checkTimeoutMs.description: Upper bound (ms) on one 'opensips -C' diagnostics run.

opensipsLsp.enable.description: Enable the OpenSIPS language server (restart applies automatically).

opensipsLsp.trace.server.description: Trace the LSP traffic between VS Code and opensips-lsp in the output channel.

opensipsLsp.diagnostics.enable.description: Run 'opensips -C' checks on open/save. Diagnostics are also disabled automatically in untrusted workspaces.

opensipsLsp.diagnostics.analyzer.description: Fast analyzer warnings between saves (undefined route() targets, duplicate route definitions), independent of 'opensips -C'.

opensipsLsp.completion.snippets.description: Insert function completions as snippets with a tabstop between the parentheses.

opensipsLsp.cacheDir.description: Documentation-catalog cache directory (empty = the platform cache dir).

opensipsLsp.codeLens.references.description: Show reference-count code lenses above route definitions.

opensipsLsp.inlayHints.parameterNames.description: Draw parameter names from the documentation at module-function call sites.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: In untrusted workspaces, diagnostics are disabled: running 'opensips -C' loads the modules the configuration references, which executes code. Completion, hover, and navigation stay available.
